recent_trades.summary: Trimming ABT from 6.25% to ~3% on the Similac spinoff announcement creating near-term uncertainty and litigation liability questions.
recent_trades.reasoning: ABT announced today it will spin off its Similac/nutrition unit. While strategically this focuses the company on higher-growth medical devices and diagnostics, the near-term overhang is significant: (1) stock is down ~4% today, approaching my stop zone; (2) the key question of who retains litigation liabilities from infant formula lawsuits is unresolved; (3) spinoff execution risk and one-time costs create earnings uncertainty. My entry thesis was Q3 earnings strength — that catalyst has now been partially overshadowed by this corporate restructuring announcement. Trimming from 6.25% to ~3% reduces risk while maintaining exposure in case the spinoff is ultimately value-accretive. The freed cash gives me flexibility as earnings season progresses.
